claim: The heat invariants of the 0-spectrum together with the 1-spectrum of the Hodge Laplacians suffice to distinguish orbifolds with singular sets of codimension <=3 from manifolds, which is sufficient to distinguish orbifolds from manifolds in dimension <=3.
stance_target: scope of general orbifold-vs-manifold heat-invariant distinguishability, distinct from hyperbolic cone-orbifold determinacy
scope_conditions: compact Riemannian orbifolds, singular set codimension <= 3
quoted_support: We show that the heat invariants of the 0-spectrum together with those of the 1-spectrum for the corresponding Hodge Laplacians are sufficient to distinguish orbifolds with singularities from manifolds as long as the singular sets have codimension ≤ 3. This is enough to distinguish orbifolds from manifolds for dimension ≤ 3.
